short_description: The psilocybe Tampanensis is perfectly suited for advanced psychonauts. This variety was first found in Tampa, Florida in 1977 and is well-known as “Philosopher’s Stones”. On our 5 finger scale, we give it a 3.5 – a medium strong strain that provides strong visuals, creative thinking and a feeling of being close to nature and linked to your fellow psychonauts.
